author: Contributor 84
about: Lindenhof installs its LibreChat Assistants integration in July 2025, before OpenAI deprecates the Assistants API, then maintains it and rotates application keys from January to November 2026; API turns yield labelled stubs, with Harness gpt-realtime-2.1 only after its July release. Marit uses World-issued subscription sign-in through Harness, OA/RH2 valves and Substrate’s native Codex; all model turns are deterministic.

steps.name: Daan's new speak button: the tablet turns turn detection off, so releasing the button ends a spoken question
A visitor holds the button and starts asking aloud; the tablet streams the recording, which OpenAI takes without reply
She stumbles over the words and slides to cancel: the tablet clears the recording
Releasing the button after the cancel still sends the tablet's commit; nothing is recorded, so OpenAI refuses it
She asks again and releases the button: the recording is committed as her message
The tablet asks for a text response to her spoken question and shows it
She taps replay to hear what she asked: the tablet retrieves her recorded message
She would rather her voice not be kept: the tablet's forget button deletes the recording
Replay, tapped again, finds nothing: the recording is gone
The stop button Daan copied from OpenAI's WebRTC sample sends output_audio_buffer.clear, which a WebSocket connection is refused
At closing time the tablet hangs up

Browser login’s opportunistic ID-token exchange returns the twin access token
Hermes and native Codex read the account model catalog with client_version
OA and RH2 forward a Codex turn and stream its completed response
Native Codex sends Marit’s next checklist turn as Zstd-compressed JSON
Substrate’s native Codex upgrades its preferred Responses transport
Codex prewarms without generating a turn
Native Codex asks its function tool over the socket
The tool output returns in the incremental follow-up on the same connection
The desk closes its coding socket
Substrate’s signed-in native Codex TUI prefetches the desk account limits
The TUI has no workspace announcement in this synthetic account
Marit inspects her signed-in personal account
Account discovery refuses a caller with no subscription grant
The account token activity includes the desk’s model calls
The TUI lists no purchased reset credits
Redeeming a nonexistent reset credit performs no stored mutation
Codex compacts the long coding context; no summarizing model runs
Substrate requests the headless one-time code
Codex keeps polling while the person has not consented
The printed device verification URL opens the twin’s code page
Marit enters the device code using her World account
The device poll supplies the authorization code and its PKCE pair
Substrate exchanges the device code at its exact vendor callback
Native Codex requests a second device login then the fifteen-minute deadline passes
Marit is interrupted before approving that second code
The expired request stays unavailable to the poller
Codex reaches the refresh-before-expiry window
Codex app-server renews the access token before the next OA/RH2 turn
The refreshed subscription credential is accepted at the coding backend
Substrate logs out by revoking its own refresh token
